notice: These are sample class-project listings. Dates and seat counts are not live availability. The displayed dates are September 19 through October 24, 2026.

workshops.name: Build a Wooden Storage Crate
workshops.description: Construct a simple wooden storage crate while learning practical woodworking techniques.
workshops.details: The workshop introduces measuring, marking, basic cutting, sanding, assembly, fastening, and simple finishing. No previous woodworking experience is required. Required safety equipment must be worn during tool use.
workshops.materials: Standard instructional materials are included unless otherwise stated. Required safety equipment must be worn during tool use.

workshops.name: Introduction to Woodworking Tools
workshops.description: Get familiar with common woodworking hand tools and selected power tools in a guided introduction.
workshops.details: Topics include tool identification, basic tool purpose, safe handling, workshop organization, measuring, cutting awareness, and personal protective equipment. This class is recommended for people who have little or no previous workshop experience.
workshops.materials: Materials information was not specified separately in the approved listing. Standard instructional materials are included unless otherwise stated.

workshops.name: Handmade Fall Wreath
workshops.description: Create a seasonal decorative wreath using mixed craft materials.
workshops.details: The workshop covers basic design layout, material selection, safe use of craft tools, attachment methods, color balance, and finishing details.

workshops.name: Soldering Basics
workshops.description: Learn the fundamentals of safe electronic soldering while assembling a simple beginner project.
workshops.details: Topics include soldering iron safety, identifying basic components, preparing connections, making solder joints, inspecting connections, and basic troubleshooting. No previous electronics experience is required.
workshops.materials: Standard instructional materials are included unless otherwise stated. Activity-specific protective equipment requirements should be confirmed before participation.

workshops.name: Design Your First 3D Print
workshops.description: Explore how a simple digital design becomes a physical 3D print.
workshops.details: The workshop introduces basic 3D modeling, preparing a model, slicing software, printer setup, filament basics, print orientation, and common beginner printing problems. Participants will prepare a small project for printing.
workshops.materials: Standard instructional materials are included unless otherwise stated. Equipment use requires applicable orientation and authorization.

workshops.name: Build a Small Wooden Shelf
workshops.description: Build a small wall shelf while practicing a range of foundational woodworking skills.
workshops.details: The workshop includes measuring, cutting, layout, drilling, assembly, sanding, and preparation for finishing. Participants should be comfortable following workshop safety instructions and using basic tools with instructor supervision.
workshops.materials: Standard instructional materials are included unless otherwise stated. Activity-specific protective equipment requirements should be confirmed before participation.
